sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • The memory sector collapsed for the second consecutive day, dominating the entire session: SNDK is now at 1580 (-9.4%), at one point plunging intraday to 1487; MU 921 (-6.2%, broke below 900 intraday to 891); WDC 531 (-8.0%); INTC 110 (-9.8%); MRVL 227 (-9.0%); LRCX 321 (-8.2%); AMD 510 (-7.6%). Leveraged ETF SOXL 157 (-19%), SOXX -6.6%, SMH -5.3%. NVDA 193 (-1.3%) was relatively resilient, stuck near the 200-day moving average.
  • The catalyst was Samsung’s record Q2 profit, which nevertheless became a “sell the news” event: Samsung guided for Q2 operating profit to surge roughly 19x YoY to 89.4 trillion won, with revenue doubling, but Seoul and SK Hynix had already fallen more than 9% last week, triggering KOSPI circuit breakers. “The strongest earnings report in history = global memory rout” became the main thread of dark humor repeatedly chewed over by the community. The market is worried about a supply glut.
  • Capital reshuffling brought by SK Hynix’s Nasdaq listing: The community broadly believes institutions are raising cash for the SK Hynix ADR listing and SPCX’s passive inclusion in QQQ, smashing memory stocks to “shake out weak hands and accumulate.”
  • SPCX (SpaceX) inclusion in QQQ weighed on the index: SPCX 152 (-5.6%) was slammed by the community as “forcing low-risk retirement money into a dealer’s game,” and was also one of the technical reasons QQQ (-2.08%) was far weaker than SPY (-0.67%). The space sector was broadly bloodbath: RKLB 84 (-9.3%), ASTS 77 (-5.1%), LUNR 18 (-5.7%), OKLO 48 (-7.9%).
  • Another tanker attack in the Strait of Hormuz: Iran attacked the Qatari LNG tanker Al-Rekayyat, while another vessel was suspected of being hit by unidentified munitions. Brent +2.4% to about $73.75, WTI +2.3%, once again exposing the fragility of the temporary U.S.-Iran ceasefire agreement.
  • Extreme divergence: Software/defensives were the only green pockets — MSFT 392 (+1.4%), META 604 (+0.7%), GOOGL 368 (+0.5%), IBM 306 (+2.3%), PLTR 135 (+1.6%), DDOG 260 (+2.0%), RDDT 203 (+1.2%); consumer defensives PEP 147 (+2.7%), KO 85 (+2.5%), WMT 112 (+1.1%). DIA was only -0.4%, and within Mag7, AMZN edged down just -0.2%.

社区氛围：极度悲观，恐慌投降情绪四处蔓延，但夹杂着大量赌徒式的抄底押注，押注“世纪V型反弹”，整体是“末日哀嚎与顽固抄底”交织的混乱基调，内存袋持有者集体崩溃，与软件/防御持有者幸灾乐祸的情绪撕扯。

恐慌/贪婪：倾向于恐慌（估计25-30，接近“极度恐慌”的边缘）。信息流中充斥着投降式的语言，例如“追加保证金电话📞”、“很快就会无家可归”、“无法让自己查看我的投资组合”和“删除了应用程序”，而“最大恐惧”则被直接喊出。但关键的分歧在于：VIX仅为16，SPY仅为-0.7%，DIA几乎持平，Mag7部分为绿色——社区痛苦的规模（许多投资组合在两周内下跌了25%~50%）远大于广泛指数的实际跌幅，表明这是高度集中在内存/半导体/空间的头寸崩盘，而不是系统性崩盘。指数层面尚未出现真正的投降。

5. 个股情绪分析

股票行情指示器提及牛/熊情绪核心视图摘要
MU90+中性（深度分裂）主战场；跌破900关口引发情绪高潮；远期市盈率 6.5 倍“极其便宜”的逢低买入者与强周期性“市盈率将降至零”的泡沫空头奋战； 1160-1250高点买家集体崩盘；重点支持850/800； 15美分股息屡遭嘲笑
SNDK70+看跌两周内从 2300+ ATH 暴跌 700 美元，跌破 1500 至 1487； “躺在那里直接被打，比MU还惨”；话费保费极其昂贵；有些人把钻石变成了收入，而另一些人则呼吁回到 250；远期市盈率 6.6 倍
NVDA40+中性至看涨由于相对弹性，整个会议的焦点；反复在 200 日移动平均线/200 美元水平附近押注； “当筹码上涨时，它算作 Mag7，当 Mag7 上涨时，它算作筹码”的二元性模因；社区多次试图逢低买入“跌破 200 不会持续”
